Visit note | 2025-09-21 03:00 PM | Dr. Asif Mahmud, Dermatology | Patient: Habiba Dewan, 20, female. Miss Dewan returns for review, stating she has itchy dry patches on her elbows and knees that become much worse in winter. She works as a police constable, and her skin flared during the dry winter in Motijheel. She has Type 2 diabetes mellitus. She reports no fever, pus, or bleeding from the lesions. On examination: affected area about 7 cm across, BP 123/75 mmHg, pulse 90 bpm, weight 54 kg. Skin is dry with mild lichenification over the extensor surfaces. Assessment: Atopic eczema. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to use a mild soap, avoid hot baths, and wear cotton clothes. Follow-up in 2 weeks.

Visit note | 2025-09-21 03:00 PM | Dr. Towhid Alam, ENT | Patient: Emon Islam, 35, male. Mr. Islam attends for follow-up, reporting frequent sneezing fits, a runny nose, and itchy eyes. He works as a CNG auto-rickshaw driver and notes his symptoms are worse since keeping a cat at home in Faridpur. He has Type 2 diabetes mellitus. He denies facial pain, fever, or wheezing. On examination: about 9 sneezing fits a day, BP 119/85 mmHg, pulse 79 bpm, weight 69 kg. Nasal mucosa is pale and boggy with clear secretions. Assessment: Allergic rhinitis. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to avoid dust, wear a mask when cleaning, and wash bedding weekly. Follow-up in 1 month.

Visit note | 2025-09-21 03:00 PM | Dr. Anisur Rahman, Ophthalmology | Patient: Saiful Bhuiyan, 54, male. Mr. Bhuiyan presents with a painful red lump at the edge of his eyelid along with swelling of the eyelid. He works as a ride-share driver and states the issue appeared after using old eye makeup in Wari. He has Essential hypertension. He denies visual loss, discharge, or double vision. On examination: lump about 6 mm on the right upper eyelid, BP 150/89 mmHg, pulse 72 bpm, weight 69 kg. Localized tenderness and erythema present on the upper lid margin. Assessment: Hordeolum. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to use a warm compress four times a day, do not squeeze the lump, and avoid eye makeup. Follow-up in 1 week.

Visit note | 2025-09-21 03:00 PM | Dr. Faisal Karim, Psychiatry | Patient: Shapla Bhuiyan, 59, female. Mrs. Bhuiyan attends for review, describing low energy and no interest in her usual activities. She works as a rickshaw puller and reports her symptoms began after losing a job in Narayanganj. She has no documented comorbidity. She denies significant sleep disturbance or appetite loss. On examination: PHQ-9 score 16, BP 114/72 mmHg, pulse 81 bpm, weight 85 kg. She appears cooperative with depressed affect. Assessment: Depressive episode. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to keep a daily routine, walk outdoors daily, start counselling sessions, and call 999 or come to the clinic at once if thoughts of self-harm appear. Follow-up in 2 weeks. The patient denies thoughts of self-harm, and a safety plan with the emergency number 999 was discussed.

Visit note | 2025-09-21 03:30 PM | Dr. Arif Hossain, Pulmonology | Patient: Kakoli Roy, 20, female. Miss Roy presents with sharp chest pain on breathing in and a high fever. She works as an office cleaner and states her illness began after caring for a sick relative in Banani. She has no chronic comorbidity. She denies night sweats or significant weight loss. On examination: temperature 103.6°F, BP 133/70 mmHg, pulse 110 bpm, SpO2 93%, weight 61 kg. Bronchial breath sounds and dullness to percussion noted at the right lower lung base. Assessment: Community-acquired pneumonia. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to rest and drink plenty of fluids, and return at once if breathing becomes difficult. Follow-up in 3 days for review and a chest X-ray in 6 weeks.

Visit note | 2025-09-21 04:00 PM | Dr. Asif Mahmud, Dermatology | Patient: Jubayer Gazi, 21, male. Mr. Gazi attends for follow-up regarding marks left after pimples, spots on his back, and active pimples and blackheads on his face. He works as a delivery rider and notes his condition is worse since working in a hot kitchen in Rajshahi. He has no comorbidity. He denies deep cystic nodules or scarring pain. On examination: about 17 inflamed spots on the face, BP 131/80 mmHg, pulse 80 bpm, weight 70 kg. Oily skin with papules and comedones across the forehead and cheeks. Assessment: Acne vulgaris. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to wash the face twice daily with a gentle cleanser and do not squeeze spots. Follow-up in 2 months.

Visit note | 2025-09-21 04:00 PM | Dr. Jannatul Ferdous, Orthopedics | Patient: Nargis Rahman, 78, female. Mrs. Rahman presents with stiffness in the morning for a few minutes and a creaking knee. She denies joint locking, redness, or recent trauma. On examination: BMI 30.7, BP 128/83 mmHg, pulse 91 bpm, weight 49 kg. Crepitus palpable in the right knee with mild restriction of full flexion. Assessment: Knee osteoarthritis. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to do thigh-strengthening exercises daily, lose weight, and avoid squatting and sitting cross-legged on the floor. Follow-up in 6 weeks with physiotherapy.
